draft.emotion: a solid and grounded feeling, describing the surface under one's feet
notes: Refers to the built floor of a room (takes the postposition पर 'on': फ़र्श पर 'on the floor'). Do not confuse with ज़मीन (zamīn), which means the ground, earth, or land (though ज़मीन is also loosely used for floor).
For a storey or level of a building ('first floor'), use मंज़िल (manzil), not फ़र्श.
